reason: Two kinds of content on a stored user message were lost or mis-sent in later model context (audit HIST-8, HIST-9). Images: after a runtime switch to a text-only model, prepare_async resolved every stored image block and sent it as an image part to a model without vision, while a client replaying full history got 'not verified for vision input' on every turn; runtime_switch_preflight said compatible either way. _model_context also sized history from text only while _ensure_request_capacity charged 2,048 tokens per image, so an image-heavy conversation never compacted and failed the capacity check on every turn. The vision check now applies only to images the request adds; resolve_chat_model_content(images_supported=False) names each stored image as '[image: <alt> omitted: this model does not accept images]' (opencode provider/transform.ts and Codex strip_images_when_unsupported do the same); _model_context and context_status estimate each message the way it will be resolved (image reserve for a vision model, placeholder for a text-only one), and the preflight sizes history for the target model. Selected context: the SELECTED CONTEXT envelope was added only to the in-memory copy of the current message, so it vanished from later turns and from the same turn's context-length recovery. _stored_model_text rebuilds a stored user message from content plus metadata.context_attachments (same _content_with_selected_context envelope), used by _merge_history, context-length recovery, compaction sources and retrieval excerpts; replayed client history is still compared against the operator's own words. tests/v3/test_history_content_fidelity.py (6 tests, all failing on origin/main) covers the text-only switch in both client shapes plus the still-refused new image, image-heavy compaction, the preflight estimate for vision and text-only targets, attachments in follow-up turns, in recovery and in compaction; the selected existing tests are the closest ones for the preflight, context-length recovery, selected context persistence, bounded compaction, durable history merging, the context and runtime-switch endpoints and context_status.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through chat.py) uses a scripted provider and does not exercise image history on a runtime switch or selected-context replay; the Python tests drive prepare, recovery and compaction directly. test_chat.py, test_context.py, test_chat_api.py, test_chat_queue.py, test_chat_goals.py, test_chat_subagents.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_model_output_budget.py, test_reasoning_recovery.py, test_native_hook_turn_ends.py, test_routing_prose_answer.py, test_chat_schedules.py and test_project_instructions.py were run locally in full (289 passed) but are not selected. No full suites.
